facts.fact: TechnoMag reports that UNDP, Zimbabwe's Ministry of Youth and Uncommon, with ICT ministry support, are launching a government VTC-based rural AI, digital and innovation hub at Nyamuroro, Gokwe, with a free one-year digital skills bootcamp for 50 youths from September 2026 and coding outreach targeting 3,000 learners and 300 teachers, in a model meant to be replicated at other VTCs.
